# Installation and compatibility

## Supported versions

| Odoo version | 17.0 | 18.0 | 19.0 | 20.0 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Supported | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |

import VersionRequest from '@site/src/components/VersionRequest';

<VersionRequest slug="ai-connector" />

Odoo Community and Enterprise, on Odoo.sh or your own server. Odoo Online does not allow third-party apps.

## What you install

| App | Technical name | Edition | License | Also needs |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| AI Connector | `novator_mcp` | Free | LGPL-3 | nothing beyond standard Odoo |
| AI Connector Pro | `novator_mcp_pro` | Pro, $149 | OPL-1 | the free AI Connector, Discuss |

- The Python library `requests` must be available on the server. It ships with Odoo, so a standard installation already has it.
- AI Connector Pro is installed on top of AI Connector. Odoo adds AI Connector automatically, and everything you set up in it stays.

## Install

1. Open [AI Connector](https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/20.0/novator_mcp) and [AI Connector Pro](https://apps.odoo.com/apps/modules/20.0/novator_mcp_pro) on the Odoo Apps Store and choose your Odoo version.
2. Download the app (paid apps: buy it first, then download it from your Odoo account).
3. Add the folder to your custom apps: on Odoo.sh commit and push it to your repository, on your own server copy it into a folder in your `addons_path` and restart Odoo.
4. In Odoo, turn on developer mode, open **Apps**, click **Update Apps List**, search for **AI Connector for Claude & MCP** and click **Activate**.

The [installation guide](../getting-started/install.md) has more detail for each kind of hosting.

## Update to a new version

1. Download the new version from the Odoo Apps Store for the same Odoo version.
2. Replace the old app folder with the new one (Odoo.sh: commit and push, your own server: restart Odoo).
3. Open **Apps**, find **AI Connector for Claude & MCP** and click **Upgrade**.

Your settings and data are kept. See the [release notes](./changelog.md) for what changed.

See [Support](../support.md) for what to include so we can help quickly.
